request: Twenty more catalog-wide passes after PR 1280, retaining the request to improve reliable coverage, simplify and measure cost.
reviewScope: Every one of the 292 rules is reviewed for each lens. Mutations run only where syntax and the rule contract make them meaningful; source-owned limitations are retained.

passes.evidence: Enumerate every existing owner, authored positive/negative contract and documented scope; introduce no new policy or severity.
Qualified call targets preserve runtime binding and their type through typeof assertions.
Satisfies expressions preserve call targets while existing provenance guards retain ownership.
Calls remain visible through erased non-null assertions; mutation and scope guards are retained.
Only non-JSX qualified call targets are transformed; type-sensitive owners are excluded.
Nested assertions preserve original AST nodes for scope and type-service lookups.
Const assertions preserve literal values and ownership; dynamic values remain excluded.
Static keys use maintained extraction where effective values are provable; protocol-key exclusions stay negative.
No-substitution keys preserve effective property names; unknown overriding keys remain excluded.
Member names retain binding and method allowlist contracts.
Binding-aware aliases and explicit same-name Python aliases preserve authored outcomes.
AST formatting applies only outside comment/docstring policy; source-owned outcomes are retained.
Token-aware case mutation leaves identifiers, quoted data and comments unchanged.
Comment spans preserve quoted data and offsets; duplicate signatures and timeout state use semantic text.
Only valid whitespace gaps outside quoted strings/heredocs/comments are changed; authored ownership is retained.
Token gaps vary without inventing statement boundaries or changing literal values.
Line endings and framing preserve outcomes. Signature decoding is limited to Markdown/JSON/YAML; shell and TOML keep their input semantics.
Policy inputs retain their own scope. Supplemental fixtures cover foreign/shadowed receivers, dynamic overrides, mutations and safe literal values.

All original suites retain precedence and coordinates; four new fixes converge. Shared recognition removes 21 redundant aliases; wrapped mutation and foreign freeze regressions prevent unsafe hoist advice.
Use verified local pins and fresh bounded processes, paired timings, full package tests/type checks/self-lint, make verify and exact-revision PR CI.

baselineEvidence.fixtureCorrections: Typed top-level-await examples declare module context at the end, preserving use-client directives. Quoted/computed protocol-key variants are explicitly labeled negative for their documented owners. No parser failures are counted as rule gaps.

admission.routing: sarj-ai/code-standards: source/configuration semantics and lint-engine facts
admission.failureMode: Valid source signatures, harmless SQL comments or erased/static-equivalent TypeScript syntax hid existing violations or created false warnings.
admission.owners: All changes refine existing owners and their shared facts; no new rules or severity changes.
admission.harm: Existing safety/test/API diagnostics become inconsistent with valid syntax; fallback and hoist warnings can be misleading.
admission.upstream: Reuse @typescript-eslint/utils ASTUtils.getPropertyName and existing scope/type services. Keep internal erased-expression and SQL comment facts at shared owning boundaries.
admission.beforeImplementation: New assertion/static-key/signature/comment and hoist regressions were labeled and reproduced before their corresponding fixes.
admission.fixPolicy: Retain existing fixes; four additional optional-array transformations have authored fixed outputs and require a clean second pass.

upstreamReferences.evidence: lintContent removes a leading UTF-8 signature before Markdown parsing.
JSON parsers may ignore a leading byte order mark for interoperability; network senders must not add one.
YAML document prefixes permit byte order marks.

regressions.nativeAdditionalCases: Timeout state, index signature/literal punctuation, signature decoding and embedded-character fixtures live in their owning tests.

corpusInspection.classification: Every diagnostic including its message retains the same multiplicity. Unchanged matches retain earlier calibration; this does not freshly adjudicate all 23,669 findings as TP/FP.
corpusInspection.limits: Corpus scans cover all 164 native rules and 112 untyped TypeScript rules. Five mandatory type-service owners and all text owners have typed/authored fixtures and full owning suites. Private identities, paths, snippets and hashes are omitted.

performance.interpretation: The paired whole-catalog medians remain within local run variation. SQL shares comment spans with existing masking and keeps two cold scanner executions, with no extra scan per index. No general speedup is claimed.
performance.protocol: Fresh process pairs alternate baseline/candidate three times. SQL cold timings exclude cProfile; separate profiles count scanner executions. Each SQL warm median has five repetitions. Peak RSS is bytes for native processes and RSS at scan completion for TypeScript.
performance.cacheBounds: Existing SQL content scans retain the same bounded 32-entry cache; current-source line indexing remains bounded to one entry. No path-only stale cache is added.
performance.timingLimit: Unpaired corpus and initial stress wall times include concurrent local load; paired medians are the comparison evidence.

release.immutableTags: Affected packages and exact sibling pins advance; no package tag is retargeted.

commands: uv run --project packages/standards --frozen pytest packages/sql/tests packages/standards/tests/test_textlint.py -q
code-standards --root . maintain rules changes --before origin/main --after HEAD
